# Multiplier catalog

A **multiplier** is anything in this repository that makes agent work more
capable, repeatable, or trustworthy. An **entry** is its machine-readable
catalog record. The [manifest](manifest.json) owns inventory and runtime
facts; the [taxonomy](taxonomy.json) owns types and curated collections.

## Browse by type

| Type | Use it for | Entries |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| Prompts | Reusable language for a bounded task or interaction. | 0 |
| Skills | Agent behavior that should trigger for a recognizable class of work. | 18 |
| Playbooks | A repeatable multi-step workflow with checkpoints and verification. | 6 |
| Setups | Configuration and host-specific wiring that makes a workflow usable. | 7 |
| Tools | Executable software that performs or verifies part of the work. | 1 |
| Briefs | A scoped idea, specification, or task packet ready to hand to an agent. | 0 |
| References | A useful external project, example, case study, fixture, or pattern to inspect. | 12 |

## Start here

A small cross-section of the catalog that shows how context, safety, writing, and completion fit together.

Entries are grouped by the taxonomy order below; each group is
sorted by the collection's explicit entry order.
| [`consequence-closure`](../skills/consequence-closure/SKILL.md) | Trace a change beyond its diff to affected consumers, evidence surfaces, maturity claims, and reusable follow-up opportunities. | skill |
| [`research-domain-writing`](../skills/research-domain-writing/SKILL.md) | Turn a domain-writing request into a researched, cited, reviewed deliverable instead of an unsupported draft. | skill |
| [`repo-aware-context`](../workflows/repo-aware-context/WORKFLOW.md) | Give an agent the right repository identity and context without collapsing instructions, source maps, and live state together. | playbook |
| [`safe-tool-guards`](../workflows/safe-tool-guards/WORKFLOW.md) | Classify and preview tool actions so destructive, credentialed, or externally visible work crosses an explicit approval boundary. | playbook |

## Inspect or adopt one

```bash
python3 scripts/workbench.py show <entry-id> --json
python3 scripts/workbench.py install <entry-id> \
  --target generic --root /tmp/workbench-target --dry-run --json
python3 scripts/workbench.py uninstall <entry-id> \
  --target generic --root /tmp/workbench-target --dry-run --json
```

See the [catalog model](../docs/catalog-model.md) before adding an entry
and the [workbench manual](../docs/workbench.md) for setup, overlays,
promotion admission, validation, and safety boundaries.
